name: Radiation Cannon
description: The Radiation Cannon was a type of portable cannon that fired radiation, making it an effective weapon when used against organic foes, leaving droids unharmed. Useful for taking out otherwise effective defenses, such as those built by clone troopers, the Radiation Cannon was utilized by the Confederacy of Independent Systems—which armed some B1-series battle droids with the weapon—during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
